title: GitHub Copilot will drop six more models on October 19, including GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4
detail: Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini and Grok 4.5 are deprecated across all Copilot experiences (Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, code completions) on October 19, 2026. Suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Luna and Grok 4.6. For Enterprise and Business customers the replacement models are auto-enabled unless an admin has disabled default model enablement.
impact: A second Copilot model cutoff inside two months, on GitHub's own schedule rather than the model vendors'. Anything pinned to GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.7 Flash or Grok 4.5 through the Copilot layer stops resolving on October 19 regardless of that model's status on the vendor's own API.
